scope.description: Implement topology_unit v2 contracts and an exact bounded structural kernel: objective/family/ranking/edge separation, dynamic obligation antichain, complete-family B&B for m<=12, objective-only terminal subset DP, multiprecision parent mapping and q<=4 differential routing.

assumptions: Incomplete families, caps and deadlines publish no winner.

step_verify.step: Separate topology objective, explicit family, abundance ranking and parent-edge endpoint in schema v2.
step_verify.verify: Three valid v2 fixtures pass and targeted incomplete-rank, abundance-parent-mapping and missing-unary-evidence fixtures are rejected.

step_verify.step: Implement dynamic obligation-antichain B&B for the bounded recurrence-allowed hypercube.
step_verify.verify: Warnings-as-errors build exits 0; complete searches retain equality ties, family caps clear partial families and node caps withhold both objective and family.

step_verify.step: Implement objective-only terminal subset DP and exact fixed-node parent factorization.
step_verify.verify: DP agrees with B&B on bounded cases and boost multiprecision reproduces an exact parent-mapping count larger than uint64.

step_verify.step: Require differential routing against the exhaustive q<=4 oracle.
step_verify.verify: Curated q1-q5 goldens plus 72 systematic q<=3 cases pass oracle/B&B/DP comparisons; m>12 abstains.

step_verify.step: Close schema, status and catalog hash locks without promoting scientific authority.
step_verify.verify: Fixture, status-code and task-state checks exit 0; topology schema/catalog locks are synchronized and no provenance or phase authority is modified.
